summary.summary: Les McCoy called back after missing a prior call to reconnect with the company about his roofing project. The representative confirmed the correct job address (6933 West Linda Sulane, Imperial, AZ 8538) and noted that another roof job for him was already completed and paid. The rep verified Les’s contact information and discussed next steps for the upcoming roof installation, clarifying that this project is a foam one-inch silicone application, that materials will be brought the day of install, and that the work should take 1–3 days depending on roof size and weather. The rep explained arrival timing (7–9 AM), asked that the driveway be clear, and outlined communication expectations including a call/text from the assigned project manager the day before or morning of installation and a final walkthrough/job completion form required to release warranty documents. The rep also advised Les to expect a pre-lien notice letter from Titan Lain Services as a standard Arizona legal notice, not an actual lien. Les had no questions and expressed strong satisfaction with the company’s prior work and confidence in the upcoming project.
key_points: Customer (Les McCoy) called back because he missed the company’s previous call and wanted to go over next steps for his roof project.
The address for the current job was confirmed as 6933 West Linda Sulane, Imperial, AZ 8538, and the customer stated the other job was completed and already paid for.

Project details discussed: foam one-inch silicone roof work; materials will be brought on installation day; install expected to take 1–3 days; crew arrives between 7–9 AM and driveway should be clear; customer does not need to be home but should be reachable by phone; final walkthrough and signed completion form are required to release warranty documents.
action_items: Customer to keep driveway clear for crew arrival between 7–9 AM on installation day.
Customer to be available by phone during installation in case the crew/project manager needs to reach him.
next_steps: Assigned project manager will call/text the customer the day prior to installation or the morning of installation.
After completion, project manager will schedule a final walkthrough and obtain a signed job completion form (or send via email if customer is not on site) to release warranty documents.
